rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for a young person or someone who looks youthful.

example.english: That young guy is full of energy.
example.jyutping: go2 go3 hau6 saang1 zai2 hou2 jau5 wut6 lik6

rows.note: Use this neutral alternative for age or youthful appearance, especially in attributive descriptions.

example.english: Books by this young writer are very popular.
example.traditional: 呢位年輕作家寫嘅書好受歡迎。
example.jyutping: ni1 wai2 nin4 hing1 zok3 gaa1 se2 ge3 syu1 hou2 sau6 fun1 jing4

rows.note: Use this for being young as a child or for something associated with one's early life, including young animals.

example.english: When I was young, I often went to the market with my mum.
example.traditional: 我細個嗰陣成日同阿媽去街市。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 sing4 jat6 tung4 aa3 maa1 heoi3 gaai1 si5

rows.note: Use this when an era, field, project, or development is still at an early stage of existence.

example.english: This industry is still young and has plenty of room to grow.
example.traditional: 呢個行業仲新，仲有好多發展空間。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 hong4 jip6 zung6 san1 zung6 jau5 hou2 do1 faat3 zin2 hung1 gaan1
